hook: You don't need a big salary to build real wealth. On a typical $60,000 income, saving 15% for 35 years could grow to over $1 million. In this video I look at it from three angles: the numbers (what an average salary can really build), the 6 mindset shifts that matter more than income, and a 12-step plan with a sample $60,000 budget you can copy.
shorts: You can build real wealth on an average salary. Here's how.
The mindset that lets ordinary earners become millionaires
The 12-step plan to build wealth on a normal income
Where every dollar of a $60,000 salary can go
Two coworkers earned the same. One retired a millionaire.
